methodology_note: Derived only from the U compact packet and targeted clean-OCR checks. The opening TOC node U.S01 is a genuine merged pair: its printed acronym glossary and body-confirmed Basic Anatomy Review are separately represented. U.S02 likewise contains body-confirmed Urologic History followed by the distinct Hematuria heading; its two TOC hematuria children are grouped as one presentation/investigation unit. U.S13's recorded Testosterone Deficiency node has body-confirmed adjacent Pediatric Urology content and is therefore represented by a testosterone unit plus pediatric units, all source-traceable to the canonical node/children. Generic child headings are grouped when they form one clinical presentation or framework; no changing regimen, threshold, or screening schedule is frozen. U.S15-U.S17 are reference/EBM/bibliographic material. All low-confidence T children retain section-inherited precision because the packet confirms they are TOC OCR sub-items without independent page anchors.

excluded_artifact_nodes.U.S17: References are bibliographic material, not a study unit.
